description:
Get a fund

One fund: the latest price, size, investors, returns, fees and risk, and its portfolio allocation by asset class (stocks, government bonds, reverse repo, deposits, precious metals, foreign securities…). Use when the user names a fund code (e.g. TTE, AAL) or asks what a fund invests in.

GET /v1/funds/{code} on Turkish funds (SBX-FON). Costs 1 credit per call.

code.description: A TEFAS fund code, e.g. AAL.
